# scm_dlp_forward_profile_list (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of Enterprise DLP Forward Profiles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all DLP forward profiles in the tenant.
data "scm_dlp_forward_profile_list" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of forward profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total` (Number) Total number of forward profiles found.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the forward profile is enabled.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the forward profile.
- `name` (String) The name of the forward profile.
- `regions` (List of String) List of regions to filter forwarded logs.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
